title: Shroobs! 🔥
description: The best enemies from the best M&L game ever in Minecraft style!! 🔥
body:
**///About Mod///**

This is an altered version of the original model made by YoshiMaker of many mobs, which replaces him with the Shroob variants.

https://discord.gg/pQnwM4gu8M

-Custom texture pack (x16)

-Models made in Blockbench

-Download the required packs for non missing textures

-Inspiration straight from Mario and Luigi Bowser Inside Story

-You need the mario_mania_1.3.ds.5 mod

-Also Forge 1.19.4 - Geckolib

-And also 1.0.2+1.19.4-forge - playerAnimator

**///Credits///**
